Coforge Hires Firm to Find New Board Chair Amid Resignations

IT services firm Coforge has engaged executive search firm Egon Zehnder to identify candidates for two independent director positions and a new board chair. This action follows the resignations of former chairman OP Bhatt and director DK Singh, which the company stated were due to governance concerns. Coforge has assured stakeholders that the board changes will not disrupt business operations, citing strong momentum in securing large deals and its focus on an AI-driven growth strategy.
